title: Hussain bant rahe hai nijaat le jao
body:
Hussain bant rahe hai nijaat le jao
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao..(2)
kuch aasuo'n ke ewaz kayenaat le jao
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye karbala hai ye mojiz numa ki basti hai..(2)
kafan mein iske lapeto, hayaat le jao
<<MINI>>
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahenge matami halqo'n se log mehshar mein..(2)
hume hussain ki jannat mein saath le jao
<<MINI>>
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Nahi karunga lahad mein mai intezaar e sahar..(2)
farishto karbobala raat o raat le jao
<<MINI>>
kuch aasuo'n ke ewaz kayenaat le jao
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasam hussain ki purse mein kam hi lagta hai..(2)
baland jitna bhi matam mein haath le jao
<<MINI>>
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha ye khizr se abbas ne yaha'n aakar..(2)
hamari mashk se aab e hayaat le jao
<<MINI>>
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae maujo'n uttho areeze ko saath lejao..(2)
Imam e Asr talak meri baat lejao
<<MINI>>
Kuch aasuo'n ke ewaz kayenaat le jao
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda utaarne wala hai sadqa Mahdi ka..(2)
Rasoolo'n aao naye mo'jizaat le jao
<<MINI>>
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahengi Fatima waqt e zahoor Mahdi se..(2)
ladayi ke liye ghazi ko saath le jao
<<MINI>>
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghume hussain mein har zakhm mojiza hai naeem..(2)
sajake jism pe kuch mojizaat le jao
<<MINI>>
Husain baan't rahe hai nijaat le jao
author: Mir Hassan Mir
